node: Defense subtier components and qualified industrial suppliers
summary: This pass expands the universe for qualified lower-tier defense/aerospace suppliers rather than primes. The strongest reference anchor is TransDigm because its public filings explicitly frame it as a proprietary aerospace-component supplier with meaningful defense exposure. The underfollowed discovery lane is more interesting in smaller suppliers such as Ducommun, Park Aerospace, and Hexcel, where exposure is embedded in aerostructures, electromechanical systems, composites, rocket-motor materials, radomes, military aircraft, space, and launch programs. These names map to the bottleneck hypothesis because they sit below prime contractors, require qualified manufacturing processes, and may be constrained by program-specific certifications, materials, lead times, customer-directed sources, and uneven defense demand. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
